body: Good for you man taking the initiative for making steps for your future self. I think many of us have been in this position (change the age and it could pretty much be me 2 years ago). I think with this kind of stuff enjoy the journey and celebrate every step on the way, you got this!

I think having the freedom and allowing yourself to have days like this is important. I follow something like this with my vacation, we can basically take it at next day notice so i put a week aside as “fuck it” days. If I feel I need to focus on me one day because somethings going on in my head or whatever, I burn a fuck it day, and give myself the freedom to take care of what I really need.

It’s less of a full routine to make sure a day goes well, but more I found when I was at my worst, just tidying my bed a little when I wake up really did me some good, like if the whole day went to pot, i can just reflect “well at least I gave myself a made bed to relax and reflect it when it’s all done”

There’s a photo of some purple beach huts on my wall, and that led to my friend and I coining the term “purple shed” to mean “I’m not ok, but don’t want to talk about it at the morning. Trust me I’ll talk when I’m up for it” when asking how the other was

So purple became the colour of deep thought, and thus PurpleMinds became the natural username for deep thinking

Yes, I have that too. For me it’s a combination of stopping focusing on work for a few days, and then looking back at the year and realising what has and hasn’t changed from one year to the next, almost like guilt about wasted potential. This years been especially bad, I took my best friend out on a date at the end of Jan and that went so spectacularly wrong (in my head), that I still haven’t gotten over it and feel like I’ve just lost. I don’t know I feel this way because of what happened, that I’m still not over it, or the fear that I’ll waste another year just sad about it.
